missionPremise: GET /api/auth/mcp-login is a standalone HTML string that still hardcodes v2 navy and #3B82F6. Stone is live on PE tokens. This card copies the used --ss-* values onto that page. Routes and copy do not change.

adversarial.claim: Linking pe-tokens.css from the HTML would keep one source of truth
adversarial.rejected: This response is a serverless HTML string with no Vite pipeline. A relative /src/styles/pe-tokens.css will 404 on Vercel. Inlining the used tokens, copied verbatim from pe-tokens.css on the same commit, is the honest standalone path.

adversarial.claim: Eyebrow should be --ss-blue because the screenshot is blue and blue is brand
adversarial.rejected: P-95 and Wave H: --ss-blue is the only action colour. --ss-gold-lt is the word SITE in the wordmark. The live blue eyebrow is the defect.

adversarial.claim: Restyle GoogleSignInButton in the same PR
adversarial.rejected: Out of WDLL. That component already uses Stone hairline plus Google published fill. Absorbing it hides an honest leftover and touches workbench sign-in.
